description_en: General and special POGO pins — high current, low pitch, and customized tips.
description_ko: 일반·특수 POGO 핀 — 고전류, 미세 피치, 맞춤형 팁.

families.name: General POGO Pin
families.desc_en: High-quality POGO-type probe pins with precision-machined plunger, barrel, and spring for stable, repeatable electrical contact across a wide range of pitches and current ratings.
families.desc_ko: 정밀 가공된 플런저·배럴·스프링 구조의 고품질 POGO 타입 프로브 핀. 다양한 피치와 전류 범위에서 안정적이고 반복 가능한 전기 접촉을 제공합니다.

families.name: Special POGO Pin
families.desc_en: Application-specific POGO pins engineered for demanding environments — high current loads, high-speed signal integrity, and ultra-fine pitch requirements.
families.desc_ko: 고전류·고속 신호·초미세 피치 등 특수 테스트 환경에 맞춰 설계된 고성능 POGO 핀.

families.name: Customized Probe Pin
families.desc_en: Probe pins fully designed to your specifications — tip shape, pitch, current rating, plating, and barrel length customized to match your exact test requirements.
families.desc_ko: 팁 형상·피치·전류·도금·배럴 길이 등 모든 사양을 고객 요구에 맞춰 설계·제작하는 맞춤형 프로브 핀.
